chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Kid Ory, Papa Mutt and Montudie playing together at 8th and Central
summary: Howard says Ory, Mutt Carey and Montudie played together at a club at 8th and Central.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I see. You've mentioned he and the kid. Or was it Kid Ory or Papa Mutt? Did we talk about the Kid Ory already? I don't think so. But let's go back to Papa Mutt. You said that Montoull and Papa Mutt were together quite a bit.
And put Kid Ory get Orrie in there. [Ory]
The three of them were close all the time, as far as playing together?
Okay, what about the Kid? What do you have on him? He's definitely from New Orleans, isn't he?
Yeah, but he played in the band with Montouly and them. You know the place down on Central Avenue?
Central Avenue and -- I can't think of the name of that.
Not the Alabam area. You mean further, 12th and Central, around in there?
Yeah. No, not that far, down this way farther, 8th and Central.
8th and Central? There was a club there?
No, I don't think I know it. But they played there, the three of them?
